common.pollHint: No WebSocket — the page polls the API every 5 s

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyText: Add a Strata engine by its base URL (e.g. http://192.168.10.76:8000) — metrics are read from /metrics.

servers.title: Servers
servers.subtitle: Strata engines polled from their /metrics endpoint
servers.empty: No servers yet. Click “Add server” to start monitoring.
servers.name: Name
servers.baseUrlHelp: Metrics are read from the /metrics endpoint of this URL
servers.apiKeyHelp: Sent to Strata as a bearer token; newer versions require it for servers exposed to the network
servers.confirmText: Remove {name} and all its stored history? This cannot be undone.
servers.clientsHelp: Only checked clients may route requests to this server. Unchecking a client without restrictions limits it to the other current servers.

server.zoomHint: drag to zoom · dbl-click to reset

heatmap.title: Load heatmap
heatmap.subtitle: Average load per time bucket, per server
heatmap.empty: No servers yet — add one on the Servers page.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Background job intervals and data retention. Changes apply without a restart.
settings.appearanceHelp: The theme is stored in this browser only, not on the server.
settings.languageHelp: Stored on your account; auto follows the browser language.
settings.viewAsHelp: Temporarily look at Pazuzu through a lower role — handy for testing. The real role stays untouched; the sidebar banner returns with one click.
settings.colorSchemeHelp: Standard uses the built-in theme; Custom lets you pick the accent and neutral palettes.
settings.scrapeHelp: How often every enabled server's /metrics is polled. 2–600.
settings.rollupHelp: How often raw samples are downsampled into hourly/daily aggregates and old raw data is pruned. 5–3600.
settings.hourlyRetentionHelp: Hourly aggregates older than this are deleted. Daily aggregates are kept forever. 7–3650.

storage.title: Database maintenance
storage.description: Raw samples are thinned as they age: 1 minute after a day, 10 minutes after 3 days, 1 hour after a week, 3 hours after a month, 12 hours after 3 months, 1 day after a year. The archive stays — it just grows ever more slowly.
storage.cleanHelp: Runs the rollups, thins every aged tier and compacts the database file. Can block the server for a few seconds.

config.title: System configuration
config.description: config.json in the project root — saved from this card by admins and applied immediately, except the database path.
config.fileMissing: does not exist yet — saving will create it
config.toastApplied: New config values take effect immediately (the database path needs a restart)
config.dbPathHelp: Relative paths resolve from the project root. Applied only when Pazuzu starts — restart after changing it.
config.authEnabledHelp: Turning it off exposes the whole API — and this card — to everyone on the network. Before turning it on make sure an admin account exists.
config.gitlabHelp: Needs auth enabled plus the base URL, application id and secret below.
config.gitlabRedirectHelp: Empty = derived from the incoming request.
config.gitlabGroupsHelp: Comma-separated; members may sign in (subgroups inherit). Empty = any user.
config.gitlabCaHelp: CA that signs the GitLab certificate; relative paths resolve from the project root; empty = system CAs only.
config.gatewayHelp: Applies on the next /v1 request; in-memory queues are not persisted across restarts.
config.queueTimeoutHelp: How long a request may wait in the priority queue before a 429. 1–3600.
config.queueMaxPerClientHelp: Protects the queue from one chatty client. 1–1000.
config.sessionIdleHelp: chat → server mappings idle longer than this are dropped. 1–43200.
config.defaultCapacityHelp: Per-server concurrency when gateway_capacity is unset and no live_slots. 1–4096.
config.ejectionHelp: How long a server that errored on a live request is skipped by routing. 1–3600.

auth.signInHint: Sign in to your Pazuzu account.
auth.setupHint: Authentication is enabled and no users exist yet. Create an admin account.
auth.setupDone: Setup has already been completed — please sign in
auth.changePasswordHint: Changes the password of the current user. This session stays signed in, other sessions are signed out.
auth.gitlabFailed: GitLab sign-in failed, please try again
auth.gitlabForbidden: Your GitLab account is not allowed to sign in here
auth.setPasswordHint: You signed in via GitLab and have no local password yet. Set one to also sign in without GitLab.

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Accounts allowed to sign in. Roles, passwords and access are managed here.
users.selfHint: You cannot demote or freeze your own account.
users.frozenHelp: A frozen user cannot sign in; their active sessions are dropped immediately.
users.newPasswordHelp: Leave empty to keep the current password. The user's other sessions are signed out.
users.confirmText: Delete {name}? Servers they created keep working. This cannot be undone.

gateway.disabledBanner: The gateway is off — turn on gateway.enabled in config.json to start balancing.
gateway.noServers: No servers yet — add them on the Servers page.
gateway.modeHelp: Route: balances new chats here. Drain: only finish in-flight, no new. Stats: monitoring only, excluded from the gateway.
gateway.capacityHelp: Max requests at once on this engine. Empty = auto (engine batch slots, else config default).

clients.title: Clients
clients.subtitle: API tokens that call the gateway. Each token gets an IP history and a queue priority.
clients.name: Name
clients.priorityHelp: Queue order when every engine is full; low rises over time so nobody starves.
clients.serversHelp: This client’s requests only route to the checked servers.
clients.serversEmpty: No servers yet — add them on the Servers page.
clients.srvPrioHelp: Home engines take this client’s requests first; Fallback engines are used only when nothing else can admit the request.
clients.debugHelp: Adds X-Pazuzu-* headers (server, queue wait, session) to this client’s responses.
clients.customTokenHelp: Leave empty to generate an pzz_… token. Paste your own to fix it.
clients.disabledHelp: A disabled token is refused immediately at the gateway.
clients.tokensHelp: Token counts are estimates unless the client asks the engine to report usage.
clients.empty: No clients yet. Add one to let a caller through the gateway.
clients.tokenOnceText: Pazuzu stores only a hash — this is the only time the full token is shown.
clients.copyFailed: Copy failed, select the text to copy manually
clients.rotateText: Rotate the token for {name}? The old key stops working at once.
clients.confirmText: Delete {name} with its IP history and usage? Its token stops working at once.

update.title: Updates
update.description: Pazuzu compares the running commit with origin every 6 hours. Applying an update pulls the new code, rebuilds and restarts the server.
update.notGit: Not a git checkout — updates unavailable
update.devMode: Dev mode — apply updates by hand (update.sh / update.bat)
update.applyText: Pazuzu will pull the new code, rebuild and restart. The gateway queue and in-flight requests are lost.
update.restartTimeout: The server is slow to come back — check data/update.log
